Part 1 · Marketing

Mexico: what the data changed

Transcript 00:09 – 14:30. The reports are built by exporting platform data and analysing it in Claude, then used to decide which promotions run, where, and on which days.

1

The weekly social numbers

Xsino: 55.59k followers, 13.28k impressions, 179 interactions across 52 posts. Heaven Online: 4,490 followers, 1,846 impressions, 79 interactions across 24 posts.

The post ranking is what gets acted on. For Xsino the top five were big promotions, the Friday giveaway, a movie, another promotion and happy hour. For Heaven Online the top three were all TikTok, then scam prevention, then the new promoter.

Promotions and giveaways out-perform everything else on both brands. That is the argument behind changing the promotion mix rather than the posting schedule.
2

Where the money actually is

Mexico is roughly fifty times the size of Taiwan, so "run a promotion in Mexico" was guesswork. The player map breaks 2026 down by state: 738 depositors and $2,717,840 MXN, of which $2,711,510 came from 720 depositors inside Mexico.

Nuevo León leads at $530,010 across 61 depositors. The column that matters most is % from top player: Nayarit's $391,401 is 99% one person, and Sinaloa, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí, Sonora and Chiapas all sit above 79%. Strip the top player out of Nayarit and $391,401 becomes $5,349.

Read the red column before the headline number. A state can look like a market and be a single whale. Coahuila's GGR is negative at −$22,186.
3

What support is spending its day on

Every 2026 chat classified by topic: 14,635 chats at 53.6 a day, 6,999 unique visitors, 1,659 identified accounts. 48.4% of chats are bonus and promo; 18.4% are verification.

Broken down: welcome bonus 2,762 chats (18.9%), codes and promos 2,729 (18.6%), KYC and SMS verification 2,698 (18.4%), other bonuses 1,267, deposits and top-ups 1,188.

The argument made in the meeting: KYC questions are usually the welcome bonus too, so one promotion is absorbing most of support's time. Time is money, so the resource should move to other promotions.
4

One provider carries the book

35 providers have play, and the top three are 76.0% of everything wagered. Pragmatic Play alone is $9,158,487 and 42.2%, at 94.9% RTP across 1,582 players and 3.63 million bets. PG Soft is 17.7%, No Limit City 16%.

This is why the meeting asked for updated top-five catalogues rather than a full refresh. Players chase the newest Pragmatic slot, and the catalogue has to show it.
5

The VIP desk, and its scoreboard

VIPs are split into five segments: A dormant, B net-negative, C grinder, D mid volume, E emerging. Each has its own monthly goal, and the panel tracks contacts, notes and channel per account.

On the day it was shown, October was at $0 of a $319,300 target ($10,300 × 31 days), with every counter at zero: 0 of 9 C depositing, 0 of 3 D recovered, 0 of 8 E reactivated, 0 of 558 contacts made.

The special VIP promotion launched the previous Thursday. For the tournament group of about seventy, the goal is to wake ten. Internal research puts one woken VIP at roughly a hundred new members, which is the whole case for staffing this desk.
✅

What changes because of this. The Welcome Bundle, unchanged for almost three years, goes back to requiring a deposit before withdrawal, because the request-to-deposit conversion keeps falling and it is pulling in free-play only. New Mancala promotions add free spins and a valid-bet tournament on Saturdays. A second-deposit bonus is wanted, pending a check that the system supports it.

Part 3 · The long item

The pending-round monitor

Transcript 23:56 – 60:40. A pending round 懸單 is the case Molly defined in the meeting: the player bet, the round finished, and the money never arrived.

🩸

The problem in one line. The provider auto-settles an unanswered round as a player loss after seven days, while the player's own screen shows a win. Until now there was no way to stop that clock. The monitor exists to react in minutes instead of days.

Two ways a round goes missing

① Settled, never sent

The provider closed the round

  • They calculated a payout
  • They never sent the wallet signal
  • Our side shows no credit, their side shows a win
  • This is the case we can now prove with their own API

② Never calculated

The provider never closed the round

  • No payout was calculated
  • So no wallet signal either
  • Looks identical to ① from the outside
  • Needs the provider to settle it, not just roll it back
🔁

Rollback is not settlement. A rollback returns the stake and puts the round back to the moment of the bet. A settlement means calculating the win that was never calculated and sending the wallet signal. Asking for the wrong one leaves the player short.

1

The monitor, split by game type

Rounds are bucketed into sports 體育, table and live 排桌真人, and other electronic 其他電子, because a sports bet legitimately stays open far longer than a slot spin.

Sports · 7 daysTable · observe 5 min, expire 15Electronic · 3 to 15 min

The windows are parameterised. Seven days for sports was called deliberately loose, to be tightened once another sports supplier starts producing pending rounds.

On screen: 322 timed out 已逾時懸單 and 1 under observation 觀察中懸單. The two export buttons send the selected rounds straight to GameArt or RP.
2

Click a round, ask the provider

Opening a round calls the provider's own round-search API and shows what they think happened next to what we recorded. In the example given, the provider counted the game as a win but never completed it, which is exactly case ①.

That turns a vague complaint into a specific claim: we never received the credit for this round, your side shows it settled with a payout of three, please confirm. Before this, the answer was always that there was no settlement.

Forcing a change to a provider's wallet signal breaks transaction uniqueness. It was called out as a principle being knowingly bent, because there is no other lever right now.
3

It is not only GameArt

Scrolling past the GameArt rows shows pending rounds from other providers in other currencies: Allforbet in THB, Play'n GO in ARS, Dragoon Soft, Mancala and Evolution in MXN. Some are ten days old.

The amounts are small, often under a few units of currency, which is why they survived unnoticed. The age is the problem, not the value.

Each row links to the round lookup, so support can go from a player complaint to a provider-side answer without leaving the screen.

How a dispute gets settled

  1. The player sends a screenshot. The game bar always carries a round or account number, so the screenshot is addressable.
  2. Look the round up here. The checker calls the game company's own API, so it is their data, not ours.
  3. If neither side has the round, the screenshot can be discarded. If the provider has it and we do not, it is case ① and they owe a settlement.
  4. The provider can still read their RGS logs to show how the round was calculated. RGS is not ours, so that step has to be theirs.
📌

The boundary stated in the meeting. The original round data lives with the provider. We cannot see the round count because RGS is not ours. What we can do is catch it first and hand the customer a specific round to argue about, which is the whole point of the build.

Posture
Find it, report it, fix it

Proactive discovery, proactive reporting, immediate handling. The same monitoring and reporting gets applied to each new customer as they onboard.

Scale
One in ten thousand

Two or three pages of pending rounds against roughly a million rounds. The rate is low; the volume makes it visible.

Deadline history
32 days → 1 week → 24 hours

What the provider successively promised. The monitor exists so the team no longer depends on that promise.

🔧 Next

🔧 Next

Rather than ours, so the client can look a round up on their own side.

Safe to deploy

Part 4 · Campaign

The Pornhub campaign for Winfun777

Transcript 61:00 – 70:00. The creative kit is built and the client has approved it. Nothing is live yet.

1

The creative kit

The kit page has two tabs, Choose your ads and Tracking links, with a Chinese toggle for the client side. Each creative carries a code, a headline, a tagline and the banner sizes it exists in: 300×250, 320×480, 950×250, 305×99, 300×100, 468×60 and 640×360.

Roughly fifty designs exist. The client has seen them and agreed with the content.

The open question is not whether the creative is good, it is which creative earns traffic on this network. That answer sits with the network, not the client.
2

Nineteen links, none live

The tracking table maps every creative to a channel. Codes encode the theme and the variant: PH_SAFE Safety, PH_WIN Big Win, PH_150 Promo A 150% first deposit bonus, PH_RD Promo B, and PH_BK backups.

Each row carries a version, Normal or Suggestive, a placement, P1 or P2, and a channel ID from 48 to 66. Every status reads Not Live.

Backups have no version or placement. They exist so a creative can be swapped without renumbering the channels.
📡

The tracking gap, raised and not closed. The campaign does not use a pixel, so no single system sees the whole funnel. Reach and impressions would come from Pornhub and Traffic Junkie, visits and registrations and first deposits from the client's back end, and messages from respond.io. Nobody had confirmed which numbers actually appear where. Access to respond.io is being given to Maho.

🚦

What unblocks the launch. The client's system update lands in two to three days, which puts the start on Friday or Saturday. Before that, a meeting with the Traffic Junkie account manager to get the network's read on which creatives and which sizes to run.
